The 'everything else left out' strategy was good, but I still gave 0.08 total to wrong spots on the rack. Future: If looking at a specific receptacle, assign high prob to the most likely item there, and near-zero to others unless they are commonly co-located (e.g., toothbrush and toothpaste, but we don't have those).
